description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for a FastAPI application, testing file upload endpoints such as '/files/' and '/uploadfile/', including validation, file size limits, and OpenAPI schema validation.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a specific module based on request parameters and creates a TestClient instance for testing FastAPI endpoints.

methods.name: test_post_form_no_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that posting to '/files/' without a body returns a 422 validation error.

methods.name: test_post_body_json(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that posting JSON to '/files/' without the required 'file' field returns a 422 validation error.

methods.name: test_post_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests uploading a small file via POST to '/files/', expecting a response with file size.

methods.name: test_post_large_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests uploading a large file exceeding the default max size, expecting a response with the file size.

methods.name: test_post_upload_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests uploading a file to '/uploadfile/' endpoint and verifies filename in response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the OpenAPI JSON schema of the FastAPI app.
